items.title: Know Before You Go: your re:Invent 2026 guide to managing cloud and AI spend
items.summary: At this year’s re:Invent, we’ve lined up a fantastic set of sessions to get you up to speed on the latest AI cost management frameworks, solutions, and real-life success stories. They will help you wrap your head around concepts, such as tokenomics, and get ahead of the AI cost management game. Across tracks, more than 30 sessions fall under the theme of cloud financial management and AI cost management. In this blog post, I highlight nine of them and share where you can find AWS FinOps experts and peers throughout the week.
items.creator: Bowen Wang
